title: The Skyparks
content: Many people on here have already posted about a large rollercoaster/theme park area, or a large Waterpark that is sometimes way high up. Anyone ever dreamt of a Skypark of sorts? Like a mix of futuristic arcade machines, team sports type games and large pools? I had a dream about a week ago about a place like that that had the Mallworld vibe to it. I was seemingly in a team with about 5 other players. It was a rather odd game. We were put into a deep swimming pool that was covered in a thick black fabric, almost like the top of an irl trampoline. This top fit over.the whole water area of the pool, with round openings in places, covered with these large colorful blobs, that looked like a cross between a football and a Frisbee. There was another team walking on top of the fabric, with another swimming below. It seems like the goal was for the swimmers to push the blobs up out of the water to a certain height. After that, we slid down this really long and wide slide, and we did cool tricks off the jumps in the slide. The whole structure was really high up, like higher than some skyscrapers.
